Banyan Software is a Atlanta, Georgia-based company, founded in 2016 by David Berkal, that is an acquirer and operator of enterprise software companies that serve global vertical markets. Headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia with offices across the U.S., Canada, U.K., Europe, and APAC, Banyan partners with entrepreneurs who build software solutions.
Banyan operates under a buy-and-hold-for-life model that provides founders a permanent home for their businesses.
Banyan is recognized as one of North America's fastest-growing private companies, appearing on the Inc. 5000 list for five consecutive years.
Awards and recognition
In 2021, Banyan earned a top 10 spot on Deloitte's North America 2021 Technology Fast 500 Rankings. Banyan was also named to the 2025 Inc. 5000 list  as one of the fastest-growing private companies in North America for five consecutive years.
Portfolio
Banyan's portfolio is across many sectors, including financial services, education, government, transportation, media and entertainment, and healthcare.
Within this portfolio are software companies that operate independently with support from Banyan. Examples of companies within Banyan's portfolio include Medicat, Loan Vision, Camis, Atamis, School Pathways, and Medtech Global.
Banyan Software Foundation
The Banyan Software Foundation launched in 2024 with the vision of using technology to drive positive global change. Created to leverage technology for a greener and more equitable world, it will focus on supporting organizations that utilize technology to do so. With a $100 million commitment of stock over the next four years, the Foundation will become one of Banyan Software's largest shareholders.
